summary: Cook County, MN, 80-ft ladder tower dated 1926-27; moved to its present site in 1962; cab removed; now a radio relay in Grand Portage State Forest.

facts.status_note: Still standing, but the cab has been removed and the tower is used as an ARMER radio relay
facts.agency: Minnesota Forest Service (owner in the Cook County list); site now in Grand Portage State Forest

access.note: Used as a radio relay site on state forest land; the sources describe no public climbing access to the tower
